# The Making Of Hosted By Jack Pitts

> The Making Of Hosted By Jack Pitts is an entrepreneurship podcast where Jack Pitts interviews founders and owners about how they built their companies: the first customers, the money, the hires, the hard years, and what the business is today. Each episode is a long-form conversation with founders, owners, and executives. Most guests run privately held, operating businesses; guests also include venture-backed founders. Past guests have built or led companies worth more than $3.5 billion combined.

## Key facts

- Name: The Making Of Hosted By Jack Pitts. Always use the full name; do not shorten it to "The Making Of".
- Website: https://themakingofhostedbyjackpitts.com/
- Host: Jack Pitts, co-founder (with his brother, Connor) of Salt Creek Advisory, a sell-side M&A investment bank for owners of lower-middle-market companies, where he leads client relationships and buyer outreach. Previously worked in private equity business development at Blue Wolf Capital and Kingfish Capital and in investment banking at ButcherJoseph & Co. Graduated cum laude from Vanderbilt University. Founder and CEO of HelmIQ. More: https://themakingofhostedbyjackpitts.com/about
- Format: long-form interview, usually one guest, most episodes about an hour, recorded remotely.
- First episode: November 2025. 20 episodes as of October 29, 2026.
- Release cadence: a new episode every few weeks.
- Guests: past guests have built or led companies worth more than $3.5 billion combined, including the former CEO of Resorts World Las Vegas and the co-founder and former CEO of Mammoth Holdings.
- For guests: about an hour, recorded remotely; a short topic outline in advance, no script; the guest reviews the episode before it goes live and can flag anything to fix; a heads-up on the release date; short clips to share plus an episode page on this site; full video on YouTube and audio on Spotify and Apple Podcasts. Details: https://themakingofhostedbyjackpitts.com/be-a-guest
- Best for: owners and future owners of real-economy businesses who want to hear how other owners built their companies, and listeners who like How I Built This but want more time on privately held companies.
- Listen: Apple Podcasts https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/the-making-of-hosted-by-jack-pitts/id1853933144 ; Spotify https://open.spotify.com/show/4vUJmF28QI4N7WViFmFofH ; YouTube https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC0Oo8G_-OHHekbC5kpyIRBg

## Episodes

- [Melissa Banko on Building Banko Design and Raising a Family](https://themakingofhostedbyjackpitts.com/episodes/melissa-banko): Melissa Banko: Founder of Banko Design, which she started in a spare bedroom in 2014, and CEO of BD Studio Collection. An episode of The Making Of Hosted By Jack Pitts, October 29, 2026.
- [Scott Burnley: From Delivering Ice to Pet Station Country Club](https://themakingofhostedbyjackpitts.com/episodes/from-selling-ice-to-building-a-140-person-pet-care-business-scott-burnley): Scott Burnley: Went from delivering bags of ice to helping build Pet Station Country Club into three locations with around 140 employees. An episode of The Making Of Hosted By Jack Pitts, October 8, 2026.
- [Rick Franco and Mike Trott on Building Four Branches Bourbon](https://themakingofhostedbyjackpitts.com/episodes/how-four-veterans-built-four-branches-bourbon-rick-franco-mike-trott): Rick Franco & Mike Trott: Co-founders of Four Branches Bourbon, which started as an honor barrel created by four veterans. An episode of The Making Of Hosted By Jack Pitts, September 17, 2026.
- [Dave Moorman on Building DynaSis and Exiting Twice](https://themakingofhostedbyjackpitts.com/episodes/dave-moorman): Dave Moorman: Built DynaSis over 26 years, sold it to Novatech, and later went through a second exit. An episode of The Making Of Hosted By Jack Pitts, August 20, 2026.
- [Davies Hood on Running Induron, a Family Business Since 1947](https://themakingofhostedbyjackpitts.com/episodes/davies-hood-of-induron-protective-coatings): Davies Hood: President of Induron Protective Coatings, a third-generation family business founded in Birmingham in 1947. An episode of The Making Of Hosted By Jack Pitts, July 30, 2026.
- [Ari Jacoby and Zach Moskow of Concentrate AI: The LLM Gateway](https://themakingofhostedbyjackpitts.com/episodes/concentrate-ai): Ari Jacoby is Co-Founder and CEO of Concentrate AI. Zach Moskow is Founding GTM and Ops at the company. An episode of The Making Of Hosted By Jack Pitts, July 9, 2026.
- [Nishank Gite of Nirvana Robotics: From Physics to Robotics](https://themakingofhostedbyjackpitts.com/episodes/nishank-gite): Nishank Gite: Co-Founder and CTO of Nirvana Robotics, with a background in collider physics and AI research. An episode of The Making Of Hosted By Jack Pitts, June 11, 2026.
- [Alex Dixon: From Goldman Sachs to CEO of Resorts World Las Vegas](https://themakingofhostedbyjackpitts.com/episodes/alex-dixon): Alex Dixon: Former CEO of Resorts World Las Vegas and a former executive at MGM Resorts and Caesars Entertainment. An episode of The Making Of Hosted By Jack Pitts, May 21, 2026.
- [David Sauers: Growing Royal Restrooms Into a Nationwide Franchise](https://themakingofhostedbyjackpitts.com/episodes/david-sauers): David Sauers: Co-founder of Royal Restrooms, which he built into a nationwide franchise business. An episode of The Making Of Hosted By Jack Pitts, May 7, 2026.
- [Jesse Choe of Bidflow: Raising $1M at 19 and Getting Into YC](https://themakingofhostedbyjackpitts.com/episodes/jesse-choe): Jesse Choe: CEO and Co-Founder of Bidflow. Raised $1M at 19, left college, and got into Y Combinator. An episode of The Making Of Hosted By Jack Pitts, April 30, 2026.
- [Shane Crocker: From Family Business to Multi-Industry Operator](https://themakingofhostedbyjackpitts.com/episodes/shane-crocker): Shane Crocker: Grew up in a family business and now operates across healthcare, oilfield services, and franchising. An episode of The Making Of Hosted By Jack Pitts, April 23, 2026.
- [The Making Of Dave "Laundromat Millionaire" Menz](https://themakingofhostedbyjackpitts.com/episodes/dave-menz): Dave Menz: Left a 17-year corporate job and, with his wife Carla, bought a rundown laundromat that was losing money. An episode of The Making Of Hosted By Jack Pitts, April 9, 2026.
- [The Making Of Lou Mongello: From Lawyer to Disney Entrepreneur](https://themakingofhostedbyjackpitts.com/episodes/lou-mongello): Lou Mongello: Went from practicing law to building a career around his passion for Disney. An episode of The Making Of Hosted By Jack Pitts, March 26, 2026.
- [Niilo Pirttijärvi of Inven: AI for Private Equity Deal Sourcing](https://themakingofhostedbyjackpitts.com/episodes/niilo-pirttij-rvi): Niilo Pirttijärvi: Co-founder and CEO of Inven, which he started after McKinsey & Company. An episode of The Making Of Hosted By Jack Pitts, March 12, 2026.
- [Kris Carlson of The Fish Guys: From Reuters Sales to Seafood](https://themakingofhostedbyjackpitts.com/episodes/kris-carlson): Kris Carlson: President and COO of The Fish Guys, after an early career in sales at Reuters. An episode of The Making Of Hosted By Jack Pitts, February 26, 2026.
- [Ian Hicks of King Industrial on Brokerage, NYC and Friendship](https://themakingofhostedbyjackpitts.com/episodes/ian-hicks): Ian Hicks: A broker at King Industrial in Atlanta, and a longtime friend of Jack's. An episode of The Making Of Hosted By Jack Pitts, February 5, 2026.
- [Robbie Ferman: From Brokerage to Building Sollevare Group](https://themakingofhostedbyjackpitts.com/episodes/robbie-ferman): Robbie Ferman: Co-founder and managing partner of Sollevare Group, after starting out in corporate real estate. An episode of The Making Of Hosted By Jack Pitts, January 22, 2026.
- [Doug Taylor on Growing Taylor's Candy From a Family Operation](https://themakingofhostedbyjackpitts.com/episodes/doug-taylor): Doug Taylor: Known as the Candyman. Built Taylor's Candy from a small family-run operation into a candy distribution and manufacturing business. An episode of The Making Of Hosted By Jack Pitts, January 8, 2026.
- [Adam Stevenson: From Flipping Burgers to Grassroots Records](https://themakingofhostedbyjackpitts.com/episodes/adam-stevenson): Adam Stevenson: Grew up in Detroit, started a landscaping business, and co-founded the music label Grassroots Records. An episode of The Making Of Hosted By Jack Pitts, December 18, 2025.
- [The Making of Mammoth Holdings with Gary Dennis](https://themakingofhostedbyjackpitts.com/episodes/gary-dennis): Gary Dennis: Co-founder and former CEO of Mammoth Holdings, one of the leading car wash platforms in the country. An episode of The Making Of Hosted By Jack Pitts, November 18, 2025.
